ABOUT ME
As an EDM artist, I'm inspired by my fans to think
constantly about the future landscape of electronic
music and where I fit in. By staying involved with the
festival circuit and maintaining an active presence on
social media, I'm able to create organically for me
and my fans which helps me foster a genuine
creator-listener relationship.
